description: Defines the TimeStatsHelper class and related data structures for collecting and representing surfaceflinger timing and performance metrics in Android.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper
classes.description: Main class providing timing and performance metrics for surfaceflinger.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::Histogram
classes.description: Tracks frequency of delta times between timestamps.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::JankPayload
classes.description: Holds data related to jank (performance hiccups).

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::SetFrameRateVote
classes.description: Represents frame rate and seamlessness preferences.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::TimeStatsLayer
classes.description: Contains timing and performance data for a specific layer.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::TimelineStats
classes.description: Aggregates timing data over a timeline with associated keys.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::TimeStatsGlobal
classes.description: Global timing statistics, including legacy metrics.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::TimelineStatsKey
classes.description: Key for identifying timeline stats based on refresh and render rate buckets.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::LayerStatsKey
classes.description: Key for identifying layer-specific stats based on UID, name, and game mode.

methods.name: HashCombine
methods.description: Combines hash values, inspired by boost::hash_combine.
